decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already requires the FAQ section to explain that the confirmation email contains the mint number serving as the referral code.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already includes the mint number and referral code among the required mint-confirmation email contents.
Adding the referral code to the confirmation email does not change the About-page content state; its message-184 changes concern automatic prize collection.
Confirmation-email display of a buyer's referral code does not change commission allocation when a mint has no referral code.
The referral-code display-location change does not alter the coded-referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or cap.
Requiring the referral code in the confirmation email does not change which identity, badges, tickets, or book access follow an NFT transfer.
The source Requirement's email-display change does not alter Transak provider selection, payment methods, wallet provisioning, seed-phrase handling, or mint destination.
Displaying the referral code in the confirmation email does not change ticket recipients or Small and Big Block ticket quantities.
The confirmation-email referral-code requirement does not change the one-time-code authentication method or authenticated dashboard access.
The referral-code display-location change does not alter the PDF.js reader engine or its dashboard and email-linked entry points.
The confirmation-email referral-code requirement does not change SIWE, supported wallet-authentication users, or protected flows.
The referral-code display-location change does not affect automatic prize transfer; the candidate's message-184 payout change comes from a separate clause.
